name: Blackrock Caverns: Crepuscular Veil from several Shadows of Obsidius builds one stack of 4 (#13822)
contract: #13822: each Shadow of Obsidius 40817 carries Crepuscular Veil 5011188, which on every landed melee hit applies
Crepuscular Veil 5011092 (-20 % healing taken, StackAmount 4) to its target. Each Shadow's copy was a separate
aura, and a new copy from another Shadow replaced the previous one, so with two or three Shadows on the same
player the debuff kept falling back to one stack. With SPELL_ATTR0_CU_SINGLE_AURA_STACK every Shadow adds to the
same aura. Three Shadows are summoned on GM Island, away from Obsidius, and the player hits each one so that all
three turn on the player (their DamageTaken hook gives the attacker the threat). The three Shadows swing in
turn, so on the broken tree no Shadow lands four hits in a row; the shared stack must reach 4 within 15 s.
Hit and expertise ratings make the player's swings land.

steps.label: CONTROL: a Shadow's hit applies Crepuscular Veil
DISCRIMINATING: the Shadows build one Crepuscular Veil stack of 4
